title: OmniSight UI app-registration manifest
description: Each SDK/device ships ONE apps.manifest.(yaml|json). The shared launcher (launcher-qt for local panels, launcher-web for headless/remote) reads it, renders one tile per app filtered by device capabilities + roles, and launches the renderer-appropriate entry. Adding an app = a manifest entry + its entry component; the shell is never edited. Validated in CI (mirrors hal/profiles/validate_profile.py).

display.description: local=has a panel (qt); headless=no panel (web only); both=panel + web admin.

default_renderer.description: Primary renderer. MUST be 'web' when display=headless (enforced by allOf below).

locales.description: BCP-47-ish locale tags. Default = OmniSight standard en + zh-Hant.

theme.description: Optional per-device theme overrides on top of the OmniSight design-system (deep-space / neural-blue). Omit to use the brand defaults.

apps.description: App tiles. ids must be unique (uniqueness checked in CI — JSON Schema can't enforce by-key uniqueness).

allOf.$comment: Decision (locked 2026-06-21): headless devices are web-launcher ONLY.

localizedString.description: Locale-keyed strings. MUST include 'en' (the fallback); SHOULD include every device.locales entry (CI warns on missing).

id.description: Stable app id, e.g. cashier, camera, settings.

icon.description: Design-system icon id (lucide name or an omnisight custom icon, e.g. camera, settings, activity, shield).

category.description: Home-screen grouping. Drives section + the category accent (diagnostics=critical-red, media=artifact-purple, communication=teal, etc.).

caps_required.description: Capabilities the device must have for the tile to show (resolved from the HAL/profile, e.g. display, camera, payment, printer, nfc, plc).

roles.description: RBAC gate; empty = visible to all. e.g. operator, admin, service.

single_instance.description: If true, re-launching focuses the running instance instead of spawning another.

entry.description: Renderer-specific launch targets. launcher-qt picks 'qml' else 'process'; launcher-web picks 'web'. At least one MUST be present; an app with only 'web' is web-only (and won't appear on a qt-only device that lacks it — CI warns).

qml.description: QML component URL for launcher-qt (e.g. qrc:/apps/CameraView.qml).

process.description: External process argv launched by launcher-qt (e.g. ["/usr/bin/cashier","--fullscreen"]). Used when an app is a separate binary, not in-process QML.
